verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
I just want to bless Your name
I just want to make You glad
I just want to move Your heart, God
To give You all I am

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
By Your will
For Your pleasure I exist
You are worthy
You are worthy, Lord

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
To worship You I live
To worship You I live
I live to worship You

verse.name: o2
verse.lines:
This is why I was made
This is why I exist
This is why I was saved
To worship You, to worship You

verse.name: o3
verse.lines:
I have been chosen
A royal priesthood
To offer up a sacrifice
Of praise of Your glorious grace
